info.description: Use a disposable/demo database. This collection creates/deletes demo records and renames/moves a demo category before restoring its name. Login and CSRF cookies are managed automatically. Native MySQL is required.

exec: const c=result.data.categories.find(c=>c.name==="หมวดปลายทางสำหรับทดสอบ");pm.environment.set("destinationCategoryId",c.category_id);
pm.test("Renamed category persisted",()=>pm.expect(result.data.product.category).to.equal("ตุ๊กตาของขวัญ"));

item.name: Populated category cannot be deleted without destination
Move gifts and delete source category
Verify moved product retains price and stock

exec: pm.test("Gift preserved",()=>{pm.expect(result.data.product.category).to.equal("หมวดปลายทางสำหรับทดสอบ");pm.expect(Number(result.data.product.price)).to.equal(Number(pm.environment.get("bearPrice")));pm.expect(result.data.product.stock_quantity).to.equal(Number(pm.environment.get("bearStock")));});
